messages:
susan_parks: Quick sync — GovCloud marketplace listing needs SOC2 attestation + a third-party pen test witnessed by our SI partner. Need to lock down the redaction flow for attachments before handoff. Who can own the scrub and the manifest?

luke_ops: I can own the S3 presign + lifecycle policy pieces. Want me to add a sample presign script and retention rule?

anita_security: I can own the redaction checklist and reviewer rotation. One ask: pen witness prefers presigned links + audit logs rather than shared creds. Can we do 48–72h presigns? :thumbsup:

susan_parks: Yes — prefer presign + ephemeral creds. @raj_k can you confirm whether the SI will do remote witnessing or require on-site access? Also need to update the partner questionnaire to call out what we’ll redact.

raj_k: Confirmed with SI: remote witnessing is standard, on-site only if they find a blocker. They require encrypted bundles (zip) and a PGP fingerprint exchange. Proposed pen window: week of May 10. Quick question — are we redacting hostnames/IPs entirely or providing a separate mapping doc?

jenna_int: Separate mapping doc + redacted bundle is the safest. We should provide a "redaction manifest" CSV that lists original field -> redaction_token -> reason. Example snippet:```json
{"hostname":"REDACTED:internal","aws_account":"REDACTED:partner"}
```This keeps auditability without exposing secrets.

anita_security: Adding checklist items:
- presign TTL = 72h
- audit log export (CloudTrail S3) delivered to SI
- bundles signed with PGP; exchange fingerprints in 1:1 chat
- redaction manifest attached to each bundle
I'll draft the checklist & manifest template today.

susan_parks: Great. Action items and owners:
- anita_security: redact checklist + manifest draft (Due Thu)
- luke_ops: presign + lifecycle + sample script (Due Wed)
- raj_k: confirm witness schedule & PGP key (Due Fri)
- jenna_int: sample redaction manifest + mapping format (Due Thu)
If any blockers, flag here and we’ll set a 30m sync. Thanks! :raised_hands:

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: "GovCloud pen prep" — Wed 10:00 AM PT. Invite sent to susan_parks, anita_security, luke_ops, raj_k, jenna_int. Meeting link: https://calendar.company.internal/meet/abc123
